The sequence has period \(20\), since
\[
\frac{(n+20)(n+21)}{2}-\frac{n(n+1)}{2}=20n+210
\]
is divisible by \(10\).

First 10 terms sum to \(40\). The next 10 terms are
\[
6,8,1,5,0,6,3,1,0,0,
\]
which sum to \(30\). Thus each full period of 20 terms sums to \(40+30=70\).

Since \(2016=20\cdot 100+16\),
\[
S_{2016}=100\cdot 70+\left(40+6+8+1+5+0+6\right)
=7000+66=7066.
\]

\[
\boxed{7066}
\]
